content.short: Ligma Node offers reliable, high-performance Solana nodes with affordable, flexible pricing.
content.description: Ligma Node provides multi-chain node access with a strong emphasis on affordability and flexibility. Its pricing plans are designed to meet diverse client needs while delivering secure, reliable nodes without upcharges. Direct validator partnerships help prioritize user transactions, supporting timely block inclusion across supported networks. This approach aims to balance cost efficiency with dependable infrastructure for developers and projects operating on major chains like Solana, Ethereum, Polygon, Multichain, Arbitrum, and OP Mainnet.
content.meta: Ligma Node is an infrastructure platform offering affordable, flexible node access. Discover Ligma Node and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
